name: @driverkit/eval
description: Replay plain-English asks against a verb list and a real model. Four numbers, and a false commit is not one of the other three.
//exports: Source, not `dist`, and it is the one package in the repository that does that.
This is a development tool: it is run out of a checkout with
`node --experimental-strip-types` against case files on the same disk, nobody installs
it, and nothing imports it at runtime. A build step would be ceremony. It is therefore
also absent from `tsconfig.build.json`, which answers `what does each package publish`;
the repo-wide `tsconfig.json` globs `packages/*/src` and typechecks it with everything else.

scripts.//test: Run from the repository root with the rest: packages/*/test/*.test.ts
